1. When the professional summary is being generated by LLM, the feedback that the LLM is working is not distinct enough, making it appear that nothing is happening.  The same is true while the LLM generating answers to the job posting clarifying questions.   
2.  Add the "Bulk Actions" buttons (✨ Accept All Recommended, ➕ Emphasize All, ✓ Include All, ✗ Exclude All) to the all of the "Review Customization Recommendations" tabs.
3. I am in the "Review Customization Recommendations" stage, but when I click on an ealier stage, the message shows stages I have not yet completed in the confirmation dialog. 
4. Clicking on "Job Input" skips the confirmation dialog.
5. The LLM should be asked to identify posssible additional "Achievements" based on the CV data, publications, job description, analysis and other context.
6. The header text on the Job Description tab should be set from the position description that was extracted by the LLM or edited by the user.
7. When I reloaded the web app after restarting the server and loaded "Senior R Package Developer at Genentech", the state is shown as 'Review', and the displayed tab label is 'Review', but the only content on the tab is the Job Description. 
8. There are currently two levels of tabs (see the image).  There should only be one level, with "Recommendations" replaced by the items in the second tab bar (Experiences, Skills, Etc).
9. There should be a tab that shows each experience and the "Key Achievements" to allow manual editing, LLM edit recommendation,  or reordering of each of the key achievements within each experience.
10. On the 'CV Editor' tab, many elements show '[object] Object' instead of text.
